method.title: Backlit droplet diameter (pixels) and scale-free d^2-law rate from FLEX HIBMS frames
method.formula: D_px = 2 sqrt(A_px / pi) per frame (A_px = filled dark-blob area at threshold f x background); D_px^2(t) = D_px,0^2 - K_px t over the a-priori fit window; K/D0^2 = K_px / D_px,0^2  [1/s]

variables.name: frame time from NASA frame index

references.citation: NASA PSI-69 FLEX, Calibration folder (HIBMS frames, frame index, test log)
Yu F, Shaw BD (2014) Interpretation of backlit droplet images from ISS droplet combustion experiments
Shaw BD (2014) ISS droplet combustion experiments - uncertainties in droplet sizes and burning rates

assumptions: Backlit frame: the droplet is the largest dark, round blob not touching the image border.
Half-intensity threshold approximates the droplet edge; sensitivity reported at f = 0.4/0.5/0.6.
Spherical droplet: diameter from area; no depth or defocus correction.
Timestamps from NASA's per-frame index; t = 0 at the logged igniter-on event.
validity_limits: Pixel domain only: no documented mm/px scale exists in the PSI calibration files, so no mm values.
The HIBMS view does not show the flame; the regime break is a droplet-side proxy, not flame extinction.
Frames with igniters in view are excluded, so the earliest burning (fastest for methanol) is unseen.
Disruption tests violate the d^2-law near the end; the break may mark disruption, not extinction.
method.uncertainty_method: 1-sigma relative: OLS slope standard error combined with D0 frame-to-frame dispersion (1.4826 MAD); threshold sensitivity reported separately; segmentation bias <= 0.35 px on synthetic disks.
validation: Unit tests on synthetic test-only disks of known diameter (8-32 px): |error| <= 0.5 px.
Scale-free comparison of K/D0^2 with NASA-reported K and D0 for the same FLEX test (PSI-69 table).
abstention_conditions: fewer than 3 free-droplet frames before igniter-on
fewer than 20 measured frames after the igniters leave the field of view
